title: Skyr: protein, calories and nutrition

seo.title: Skyr nutrition: protein, calories and sugar
seo.meta_description: A current plain skyr provides 17 g protein and 120 calories per 150 g. See how skyr concentrates protein and how whole-milk and flavored versions differ.
seo.search_intent: Understand skyr protein, calories and nutrition

excerpt: Plain skyr can pack a large amount of protein into a small cup. Icelandic Provisions Plain Skyr currently provides 17 g protein, 120 calories, 2.5 g fat and 3 g sugar per 150 g—about 11.3 g protein and 80 calories per 100 g.
content_html:
Skyr looks like thick yogurt, but its most useful nutrition feature is concentration: a relatively small serving can provide a lot of milk protein.

A current plain skyr label

Icelandic Provisions Plain Skyr lists per 150 g cup:

  • 120 calories
  • 17 g protein
  • 2.5 g fat
  • 3 g total sugar
  • 0 g added sugar
  • 190 mg calcium

Normalized to 100 g, that is about 80 calories and 11.3 g protein.

Why is protein so high?

Traditional skyr production ferments milk and removes whey, concentrating milk solids. Modern commercial processes vary, but the dense protein profile remains a defining practical feature.

Plain and flavored are different products

The same brand's vanilla skyr provides 15 g protein and 130 calories per 150 g, with 6 g added sugar. Flavoring does not make skyr nutritionally bad, but it changes what the cup contains.

Skyr is not always fat-free

Whole Milk Plain Skyr from the same company has 6 g fat and 130 calories per 170 g. The word “skyr” does not guarantee one fat level.

What is a realistic protein contribution?

One 150 g plain cup gives 17 g protein. That is more informative than quoting protein per 100 g when the package itself is a common single serving.

Skyr's appeal is therefore straightforward: concentrated dairy protein, usually with relatively little added sugar when plain.

faq.question: How much protein is in skyr?
faq.answer: The plain product used here provides 17 g per 150 g cup, about 11.3 g/100 g.

faq.question: How many calories are in skyr?
faq.answer: 120 calories per 150 g in the plain low-fat example.

faq.question: Does plain skyr have added sugar?
faq.answer: The product cited has 0 g added sugar and 3 g total sugar.

faq.question: Is all skyr nonfat?
faq.answer: No. Whole-milk versions exist and contain more fat and calories.
